_about: Games added from 2026-10 (4 waves). tools/build_new_games.py turns this into the hub sections, menu, maps, i18n and SW cache. A game is published only when js/games/<id>.js exists. English first; other languages fall back to the English text.

sections.title: Cards & Board Games
sections.sub: The table games you know by heart, against a patient computer.

sections.title: Words & Numbers
sections.sub: Puzzles to sit down with, at your own pace.

sections.title: Nostalgia Trivia: the 50s to the 80s
sections.sub: Real songs, shows, faces and prices from the years we remember.

sections.title: Retro Arcade
sections.sub: Original games in the spirit of the arcade classics. Slow to start, with big controls.

games.title: FreeCell
games.desc: The solitaire where every card is face up.
games.inst: Tap a card, then tap where it goes. Each free cell holds one card.
games.why: Every card is visible, so it is all planning: thinking several moves ahead.

games.title: Spider Solitaire
games.desc: One suit: build runs from King down to Ace.
games.inst: Tap a card to move it with the cards on top of it. Tap Deal for a new row.
games.why: Keeping columns open for later is the whole game: planning with limited space.

games.title: Checkers
games.desc: The classic board game against a friendly computer.
games.inst: Tap your piece, then tap where it goes. If you can jump, you must.
games.why: Seeing what your opponent can do next is the skill behind every good move.

games.title: Backgammon
games.desc: Race your checkers home against the computer.
games.inst: Roll the dice, tap a checker, then tap a highlighted point.
games.why: Counting moves on the dice and weighing risks, roll after roll.

games.title: Dominoes
games.desc: The block game: match the ends and play out your hand first.
games.inst: Tap a domino that matches an open end. If it fits both ends, choose a side.
games.why: Matching numbers while keeping the tiles you will need later.

games.title: Crazy Eights
games.desc: Match the suit or the rank. Eights are wild.
games.inst: Tap a card that matches the top card. No match? Draw from the deck.
games.why: Watching suits and ranks change and saving your eights for the right moment.

games.title: Gin Rummy
games.desc: Make sets and runs, then knock before the computer does.
games.inst: Draw from the deck or the discard pile, then tap a card to throw away. Knock when your deadwood is 10 or less.
games.why: Grouping cards into sets and runs while remembering what has been thrown away.

games.title: Go Fish
games.desc: Ask for cards and collect sets of four.
games.inst: Tap a card in your hand to ask the computer for that rank.
games.why: Remembering what the other player asked for is how you win at Go Fish.

games.title: Anagrams
games.desc: How many words can you make from six letters?
games.inst: Tap letters to spell a word, then tap Enter. Find the target number of words.
games.why: Searching your vocabulary for words hidden in the same few letters.

games.title: Daily Mini Crossword
games.desc: A small American crossword with friendly clues.
games.inst: Tap a square, read the clue, and type with the big keyboard.
games.why: Matching a clue to a word that fits the letters you already have.

games.title: Picture Logic
games.desc: Fill the grid by the numbers to reveal a picture.
games.inst: The numbers say how many squares in a row are filled. Tap a square to fill it.
games.why: Pure deduction: each number rules some squares in and others out.

games.title: Minesweeper
games.desc: Clear the field without touching a mine.
games.inst: Tap a square to open it. The numbers count nearby mines. Switch to Flag to mark one.
games.why: Reading the numbers around you to work out where it is safe.

games.desc: Slide and join matching tiles to reach 2048.
games.inst: Use the big arrows (or swipe) to slide all tiles. Equal tiles join.
games.why: Keeping your big tiles in a corner takes a plan, not luck.

games.title: Spot the Difference
games.desc: Two pictures, five differences. Can you find them?
games.inst: Tap a difference on either picture. Take your time.
games.why: Comparing two scenes part by part is careful visual attention.

games.title: Finish the Song Title
games.desc: Complete the names of the hits of the 50s, 60s and 70s.
games.inst: Read the start of a famous song title and pick the missing words.
games.why: Bringing back the music you grew up with, one title at a time.

games.title: Who Sang It?
games.desc: Name the singer or group behind the hit.
games.inst: Read the song and the year, then pick who recorded it.
games.why: Linking a song to its singer is long-term memory at work.

games.title: Movie Quote Quiz
games.desc: Famous lines from the movies of the 60s to the 80s.
games.inst: Read the famous line and pick the movie it comes from.
games.why: A single line can bring back a whole film: recall from a small cue.

games.title: TV Trivia
games.desc: The American shows of the 60s, 70s and 80s.
games.inst: Read the question about a classic show and pick the right answer.
games.why: Remembering the shows, the characters and the places they were set.

games.title: Name That Year
games.desc: When did it happen? Pick the year.
games.inst: Read about a moment in history and pick the year it happened.
games.why: Placing events in time is how we organise what we remember.

games.title: Famous Faces
games.desc: Name the famous Americans of the era from their photos.
games.inst: Look at the photo and pick the person's name.
games.why: Putting a name to a face is one of the oldest memory skills we have.

games.title: Vintage Brands & Slogans
games.desc: The slogans and jingles we all heard on TV.
games.inst: Read the slogan and pick the brand that used it.
games.why: Slogans heard a thousand times stay with us: recall from a short cue.

games.title: Then vs Now Prices
games.desc: What did a stamp or a gallon of gas cost back then?
games.inst: Read the year and the item, then pick the price it really had.
games.why: Comparing then and now, with numbers from official records.

games.title: States & Capitals
games.desc: Name the capital of each of the 50 states.
games.inst: Read the state and pick its capital city.
games.why: The capitals we learned in school, brought back by practice.

games.title: Star Defender
games.desc: Hold back the rows of alien ships before they land.
games.inst: Move with the big arrows and press Fire. Shields protect you.
games.why: Timing your shots while watching the whole sky.

games.title: Space Rocks
games.desc: Turn, thrust and blast the drifting rocks.
games.inst: Turn left or right, press Thrust to move and Fire to shoot. Big rocks break into small ones.
games.why: Steering in every direction keeps your sense of space busy.

games.title: Paddle Tennis
games.desc: The first video game feeling: bat the ball past the computer.
games.inst: Drag the paddle or use the big buttons. First to 5 points wins.
games.why: Following a moving ball and meeting it in time.

games.title: Brick Breaker
games.desc: Bounce the ball and knock out the colored bricks.
games.inst: Move the paddle with your finger or the big buttons. Keep the ball in play.
games.why: Judging angles and getting there before the ball does.

games.title: Road Crossing
games.desc: Help the chicken cross the busy road and the river.
games.inst: Use the big arrows to hop. Wait for a gap in the traffic and ride the logs.
games.why: Waiting for the right moment is a skill in itself.

games.title: Shooting Gallery
games.desc: The fairground classic: tap the targets as they glide by.
games.inst: Tap the ducks and targets. Leave the bonus stars for extra points.
games.why: Spotting and tapping the right target quickly.

games.title: Snake
games.desc: Eat the apples and grow longer without hitting yourself.
games.inst: Turn with the big arrows or swipe. The snake starts slow.
games.why: Planning a path for a body that keeps getting longer.

games.title: Pop-Up Moles
games.desc: Tap the moles as they pop up from their holes.
games.inst: Tap a mole when it pops up. Leave the bunnies alone.
games.why: Reacting fast while holding back from the wrong target.
